about: Snatch takes Victory Dance (Pokemon Central, Danzavittoria: "Può essere rubata da Scippo"; Showdown's gen-9 victorydance has the snatch flag), and the twelve other added moves Pokemon Central says it takes -- Aurora Veil, Clangorous Soul, Fillet Away, Gear Up, Laser Focus, Life Dew, Lunar Blessing, Magnetic Flux, Mat Block, Shelter, Shore Up and Stuff Cheeks -- whose engine records left the flag off. A level-10 Pikachu is given Victory Dance in the running battle (teach:) against a forced wild level-5 Chansey that knows only Snatch: the Chansey snatches the dance and its own stats rise (on the base ROM the Pikachu danced and the Snatch failed). The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.
